$comment: Critical and serious axe violations each surface may still have, as node counts per rule, keyed <surface>/<mode>. A count above its entry fails the gate. Counts are the larger of CI (Linux) and Windows, whose fonts lay some controls out differently. Counts may only fall: check-baseline.mjs compares this file with the base branch, and `node check-baseline.mjs --update` lowers them from a run. owners names the 2.0 work package that removes each rule's violations.

owners.color-contrast: N11 Canvas and forced-colours fixes (A11Y-13): accents and tags under 4.5:1
owners.label-content-name-mismatch: N19 Accessible names contain the visible label (WCAG 2.5.3; STATUS.tsv row added by G2, since the audit predates the axe 4.14 rule): the suite's profile and workspace buttons, PowerPoint's Shadow command and Fit zoom, Excel's formula bar fx
owners.target-size: P8 Ribbon navigation and reflow (A11Y-18d): ribbon split-button carets under 24 px in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio. A11Y-18 was N9's; N9 merged without 18d and moved it to P8, which owns the ribbon
